query:
-- day_0 touch status breakdown
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as cnt, MIN(sentAt) as first_sent, MAX(sentAt) as last_sent
FROM leadSequenceQueue
WHERE sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture' AND touchKey = 'day_0_camp_overview'
GROUP BY status;
